description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pitipana North, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520006
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Nos. 375, 376, and 163) with detailed property information including parcel numbers, extents, owner names, addresses, identity card numbers, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
